sql:
SELECT
  psc.ProductSubcategoryName,
  toYear(f.DateKey) AS SalesYear,
  sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(toDate(p.AvailableForSaleDate)) = toYear(f.DateKey)) AS NewProductSales,
  sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(toDate(p.AvailableForSaleDate)) < toYear(f.DateKey)) AS ExistingProductSales,
  countDistinctIf(f.ProductKey, toYear(toDate(p.AvailableForSaleDate)) = toYear(f.DateKey)) AS NewProductCount,
  countDistinctIf(f.ProductKey, toYear(toDate(p.AvailableForSaleDate)) < toYear(f.DateKey)) AS ExistingProductCount,
  ExistingProductSales - anyIf(ExistingProductSales, 0) AS _placeholder
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS psc ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = psc.ProductSubcategoryKey
WHERE p.AvailableForSaleDate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY psc.ProductSubcategoryName, SalesYear
ORDER BY psc.ProductSubcategoryName, SalesYear
